<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sahil Sharma — Portfolio</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollToPlugin.min.js"></script>

<style>

:root{
  --ink:#0e0e0e;--ink2:#161616;--ink3:#1e1e1e;
  --gold:#f0c060;--gold-dim:#c89a3a;--gold-line:rgba(240,192,96,.18);
  --ash:#f4f0e8;--ash2:#c8c4bc;--fog:#6e6a62;
}
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif;background:var(--ink);color:var(--ash2);overflow-x:hidden;}
a{text-decoration:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}

/* NAV */
#nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1.5rem 5vw;transition:padding .35s,background .35s,border-color .35s;border-bottom:1px solid transparent; cursor: auto;}
#nav.s{padding:.85rem 5vw;background:rgba(14,14,14,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-color:var(--gold-line);}
.nav-logo{font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:1.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold);}
.nav-ul{display:flex;gap:2.4rem;list-style:none;}
.nav-ul a{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);transition:color .2s;position:relative;padding-bottom:2px;}
.nav-ul a::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .3s;}
.nav-ul a:hover{color:var(--gold);}
.nav-ul a:hover::after{width:100%;}
.nav-hire{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.55rem 1.4rem;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border-radius:4px;transition:all .25s;}
.nav-hire:hover{background:var(--gold-dim);transform:translateY(-1px);}

/* HERO */
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:55% 45%;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-img img, .hero-img video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 10%;filter:brightness(.78) contrast(1.12);display:block;transition:filter .7s;}
.hero-img:hover img, .hero-img:hover video{filter:brightness(.88) contrast(1.06);}
.hero-img::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 40%,rgba(14,14,14,.6) 75%,var(--ink) 100%);pointer-events:none;}
.hero-img::before{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:35%;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--ink),transparent);z-index:1;pointer-events:none;}
.hero-card{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;left:2rem;z-index:5;background:rgba(14,14,14,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.22);border-radius:14px;padding:1.1rem 1.5rem;opacity:0;}
.hero-card-name{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.15rem;}
.hero-card-tag{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);}
.hero-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:6rem 5vw 6rem 3.5rem;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1.6rem;opacity:0;}
.pip{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;animation:pip 2s infinite;}
@keyframes pip{0%,100%{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(240,192,96,.4);}50%{opacity:.4;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(240,192,96,0);}}
.hero-h1{font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:clamp(4.5rem,9vw,9rem);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.12em;opacity:0;}
.hero-h1 .g{color:var(--gold);display:block;}
.hero-role{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);margin-bottom:2rem;opacity:0;}
.hero-bio{font-size:.97rem;line-height:1.85;color:var(--ash2);max-width:380px;font-weight:300;margin-bottom:2.4rem;opacity:0;}
.hero-bio b{color:var(--ash);font-weight:600;}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;opacity:0;}
.btn-fill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;padding:.9rem 2rem;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:5px;transition:all .28s;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(240,192,96,.2);}
.btn-fill:hover{background:var(--gold-dim);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(240,192,96,.28);}
.btn-line{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;padding:.9rem 1.8rem;background:transparent;color:var(--ash2);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:5px;transition:all .28s;}
.btn-line:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.hero-nums{display:flex;gap:2.5rem;margin-top:2.8rem;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--gold-line);opacity:0;}
.hero-num-val{font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1;}
.hero-num-lbl{font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);margin-top:.2rem;}

/* SHARED */
.sec{padding:6.5rem 5vw;position:relative;}
.sec-alt{background:var(--ink2);}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);background:rgba(240,192,96,.07);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.2);padding:.3rem .9rem;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:1.1rem;}
.sec-h{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,4.2rem);color:var(--ash);line-height:1.08;margin-bottom:.45rem;}
.sec-h em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold);}
.sec-sub{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--fog);max-width:480px;line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;margin-bottom:3rem;}
.sec-rule{width:48px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-dim));border-radius:2px;margin:1rem 0 2.5rem;}

/* ABOUT */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center;}
.id-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(240,192,96,.07),rgba(240,192,96,.02));border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.14);border-radius:20px;padding:2.8rem 2.4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;}
.id-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);}
.id-avatar{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(240,192,96,.2),rgba(200,154,58,.08));border:2px solid rgba(240,192,96,.25);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 1.4rem;position:relative;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(240,192,96,.12);font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:2.6rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.05em;}
.id-avatar::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(240,192,96,.2);animation:spin 14s linear infinite;}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.id-name{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1.55rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.25rem;}
.id-role{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);margin-bottom:2rem;}
.id-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.75rem;}
.id-stat{background:rgba(240,192,96,.04);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:.9rem;transition:all .3s;}
.id-stat:hover{background:rgba(240,192,96,.1);border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.3);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.id-stat-n{font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1;}
.id-stat-l{font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);margin-top:.15rem;}
.about-txt p{font-size:.97rem;line-height:1.9;color:var(--ash2);margin-bottom:1.1rem;font-weight:300;}
.about-txt p b{color:var(--ash);font-weight:600;}
.fact-rows{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.7rem;margin-top:2rem;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--gold-line);}
.fact-rows li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;font-size:.87rem;color:var(--ash2);}
.fact-ico{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(240,192,96,.07);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.13);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:.9rem;}

/* SKILLS */
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:1.2rem;}
.sk-card{background:var(--ink2);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.07);border-radius:16px;padding:1.8rem;transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:default;}
.sk-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-dim),var(--gold));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .38s ease;}
.sk-card:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1);}
.sk-card:hover{border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.25);transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
.sk-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;margin-bottom:1.3rem;}
.sk-icon-wrap{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(240,192,96,.08);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.14);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.sk-ct{font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:1.1rem;color:rgba(240,192,96,.18);letter-spacing:.05em;margin-left:auto;}
.sk-ttl{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.9rem;}
.sk-pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;}
.sk-pill{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(240,192,96,.05);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.11);color:var(--ash2);transition:all .2s;}
.sk-pill:hover{background:rgba(240,192,96,.15);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);}

/* PROJECTS */
.proj-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.3rem;perspective: 1200px;}
.proj-card{background:var(--ink2);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.07);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:border-color .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;transform-style: preserve-3d;will-change: transform;}
.proj-card:hover{border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.26);transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 24px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
.proj-top{padding:2rem 2rem 1.5rem;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(240,192,96,.07),rgba(240,192,96,.01));border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.06);transform: translateZ(20px);}
.proj-no{font-family:"Bebas Neue",cursive;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:rgba(240,192,96,.5);margin-bottom:.8rem;transform: translateZ(10px);}
.proj-ico-wrap{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(240,192,96,.1);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.18);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.4rem;transform: translateZ(40px);box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);}
.proj-body{padding:1.5rem 2rem 2rem;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform: translateZ(20px);}
.proj-ttl{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.6rem;transform: translateZ(15px);}
.proj-desc{font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--fog);font-weight:300;margin-bottom:1.4rem;flex:1;transform: translateZ(10px);}
.proj-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;}
.p-tag{font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.25rem .65rem;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(240,192,96,.08);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.15);color:var(--gold);}

/* EDUCATION */
.edu-track{position:relative;padding-top:3rem;}
.edu-line-bar{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--gold-dim),rgba(240,192,96,.08));}
.edu-nodes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2rem;}
.edu-node{position:relative;padding-top:2.2rem;transition:all .3s;opacity:0;}
.edu-node::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-5px;left:0;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(240,192,96,.5);transition:all .3s;}
.edu-node:hover::before{background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(240,192,96,.7);transform:scale(1.3);}
.edu-yr{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:.5rem;}
.edu-deg{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.3rem;}
.edu-sch{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--fog);font-weight:300;margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.edu-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.25rem .8rem;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(240,192,96,.1);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.22);color:var(--gold);}

/* STRENGTHS */
.str-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1.1rem;}
.str-card{background:var(--ink);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.07);border-radius:14px;padding:2rem 1.4rem;text-align:center;cursor:default;transition:all .32s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.str-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,rgba(240,192,96,.08),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;}
.str-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.3);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
.str-card:hover::after{opacity:1;}
.str-ico-wrap{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(240,192,96,.08);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 1rem;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.3rem;transition:all .3s;}
.str-card:hover .str-ico-wrap{background:rgba(240,192,96,.16);border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.4);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,192,96,.2);}
.str-lbl{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ash);}

/* EXTRAS */
.ext-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.8rem;}
.ext-box{background:var(--ink2);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.08);border-radius:16px;padding:2.4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.ext-box::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-dim),var(--gold),var(--gold-dim));}
.ext-ttl{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:1.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;}
.ext-ttl i{color:var(--gold);}
.act-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem;}
.act-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ash2);padding:.55rem 1.1rem;background:rgba(240,192,96,.04);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.1);border-radius:8px;transition:all .22s;}
.act-item i{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--gold);}
.act-item:hover{background:rgba(240,192,96,.11);border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.3);color:var(--gold);}
.lang-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:.75rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.06);}
.lang-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.lang-n{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ash2);font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;}
.lang-n i{color:var(--gold);font-size:.85rem;}
.lang-dots{display:flex;gap:5px;}
.ld{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(240,192,96,.1);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.16);}
.ld.on{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(240,192,96,.45);}

/* CONTACT */
.con-full{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:3rem;align-items:start;}
.con-socials{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.9rem;}
.con-soc-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.1rem;padding:1.2rem 1.5rem;background:var(--ink);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.08);border-radius:13px;color:var(--ash2);transition:all .3s;text-decoration:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.con-soc-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(240,192,96,.05),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;}
.con-soc-card:hover{border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.3);transform:translateX(6px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
.con-soc-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.con-soc-card.no-link{cursor:default;}
.con-soc-card.no-link:hover{transform:none;border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.08);box-shadow:none;}
.con-soc-ico{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:11px;flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(240,192,96,.09);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.1rem;transition:all .3s;}
.con-soc-ico.linkedin{background:rgba(10,102,194,.15);border-color:rgba(10,102,194,.25);color:#4da6ff;}
.con-soc-ico.insta{background:rgba(225,48,108,.12);border-color:rgba(225,48,108,.22);color:#f77ab0;}
.con-soc-ico.phone{background:rgba(52,199,89,.12);border-color:rgba(52,199,89,.22);color:#5ee083;}
.con-soc-card:hover .con-soc-ico{transform:scale(1.08);}
.con-soc-lbl{font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);margin-bottom:.15rem;}
.con-soc-val{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ash2);}
.con-soc-arrow{margin-left:auto;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--fog);opacity:0;transition:all .3s;}
.con-soc-card:hover .con-soc-arrow{opacity:1;color:var(--gold);}

.con-form-wrap{background:var(--ink);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.1);border-radius:18px;padding:2.4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.con-form-wrap::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-dim),var(--gold),var(--gold-dim));}
.con-form-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:2rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.08);}
.con-form-hico{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:11px;flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(240,192,96,.1);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.18);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.1rem;}
.con-form-title{font-family:"Instrument Serif",serif;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--ash);margin-bottom:.15rem;}
.con-form-sub{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--fog);font-weight:300;}
.con-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.2rem;}
.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;}
.form-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;}
.form-label{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fog);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;}
.form-label i{color:var(--gold);font-size:.68rem;}
.form-inp{background:var(--ink2);border:1px solid rgba(240,192,96,.1);border-radius:9px;padding:.85rem 1.1rem;font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ash);outline:none;transition:border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;width:100%;}
.form-inp::placeholder{color:var(--fog);}
.form-inp:focus{border-color:rgba(240,192,96,.4);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(240,192,96,.07);}
.form-textarea{resize:none;height:130px;line-height:1.7;}
.form-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.7rem;padding:1rem 2rem;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(240,192,96,.2);width:100%;margin-top:.3rem;}
